note:
Supporting evidence from the same window (2026-08-05T11:15Z), which VALIDATES the progress-keyed predicate proposed in the body and rules out a simpler respawn-count bound:

#2079 COMPLETED with 2 session-auto-respawn markers (merged=True, completed 11:10Z). #1992 currently has 2 respawns and is still advancing (last real marker 10:43Z). So a respawn is NOT by itself evidence of a defect, and a naive 'N respawns => bug' bound would have false-positived on both.

The distinguishing signal is exactly the one the body specifies: N respawns with NO intervening REAL (non-watcher) marker. #2079 and #1992 made progress between respawns; #2004 has made none since its 02:54Z completion-audit PASS (now 8h21m, 7 respawns, unchanged this cycle) and #2022 none since 06:08Z (4 respawns).

Do not weaken the predicate to a raw count.

Measurement caveat for whoever picks this up: counting respawns with a grep for the literal string over the full 'task.py view --json' output is WRONG — it also matches body/origin-prompt text. On THIS task (#2084) that method returns 8, which is spurious (the body describes respawns). Count distinct respawn-marker timestamps instead; that is how the #2004=7 and #2022=4 figures in the body were cross-checked.

Follow-up evidence 2026-08-05T12:03Z — one of the two motivating examples RECOVERED, so the body's #2004 case is now partly stale. Read this before planning.

#2004: posted a REAL (non-watcher) marker at 11:18Z after 8h21m of nothing. It did NOT need intervention; the loop broke on its own at 7 respawns. So the shape is SLOW-BUT-RECOVERABLE at least sometimes, not reliably terminal. Weight the body's '7h34m no progress' framing accordingly.

Still stuck at this reading: #2022 (5 respawns, up from 4; no real marker since its 06:08Z completion-audit PASS, 5h53m) and #1992 (2 respawns; no real marker since 08:11Z, 3h50m).

This strengthens rather than weakens the case for an ESCALATE-ONLY bound: had a naive bound killed #2004 at 3 or 5 respawns, it would have destroyed a task that recovered. Whatever bound lands must surface the condition to a human, not terminate the session.

Second measurement caveat, compounding the one in my previous note: even filtering by kind=='epm:progress' AND 'session-auto-respawn' in note gives a FALSE count on THIS task, because my own notes here contain that literal string. Any counter must exclude the task's own commentary — or just count on the affected tasks (#2004/#2022/#1992), never on #2084 itself.
